source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of threats (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Kitab online services ke istemal mein khatron ki paanch bari qismein batati hai: spam, spyware, cookies, phishing aur pharming.

blocks.alt: Baen: terms of use ki aam shiqon ke paanch dabbe, user obligations, limitation of liability, privacy and data use, intellectual property aur termination of service, har ek misal ke saath, aur users ke huqooq. Daen: table jo spam, spyware, cookies, phishing aur pharming ko un ke kaam aur bachao se milati hai: spam filter, antivirus, cookie management, bhejne wale ki jaanch aur https aur taale ki jaanch.
blocks.caption: Terms of use, online khatre aur bachao (topics 7.1 aur 7.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Terms of use batate hain ke user ko kya karna hai, provider ki zimmedari mehdood karte, data ka istemal samjhate, provider ki intellectual property bachate aur batate hain ke account kab band ho sakta hai; users ke paas privacy, maloomat aur raza wapas lene ke huqooq rehte hain. Spam ghair matloob offers ki bharmar karta aur spam filter se rukta hai; spyware chhup kar nigrani karta aur antivirus se pakra jata hai; cookies login yaad rakhti magar peecha kar sakti hain, to inhein manage karein; phishing bank ban kar jaali paigham bhejti hai, to bhejne wala jaanchein aur links na dabayein; pharming asal site ki jaali copy par le jati hai, to address, https aur taala jaanchein.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke paanch khatre bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Spam, spyware, cookies, phishing aur pharming.

items: Paanch khatre: spam, spyware, cookies, phishing, pharming.
